review_independence: Independent review of parent-authored analysis code; reviewer authored the diagnostic specification, so this is not an independent scientific-design review.

checks.cohort: Source143 closure and selected epochs 5/5/22 fixed; native complete verifier and selected history/metadata/binary SHA checked before reading new on/off rows.
checks.same_diagnostic: Both conditions read exclusively from the new diagnostic originals/data_receipts. No verify_baseline or old helper run/main invocation. Frozen helper constants mentioning old CNN are not prediction reads.
checks.target_identity: Exact new-domain target/truth/history join, unique target IDs, dataset/seed/split/entity/seq checks; no native-versus-exporter target digest direct equality.
checks.fixed_conditions: Reuses pinned pure arithmetic with exactly15 conditions, unchanged Train Q25/Q75 recalculated from eligible Train rows and checked against prior frozen values; no target-derived cuts.
checks.weighting: Row weights 1; each condition intersects Train/Validation entity sets, weights each retained row by inverse entity count, normalizes by entity mass. Support/excluded rows retained. Different-support weighted cells are not summed.
checks.direction: candidate mapped to off and cnn mapped to on only in output metrics; paired delta is off minus on. Output expressly states off is neither historical CNN nor a separately retrained model.
checks.unfavorable: All180 per-seed condition/split/weighting records retained, including empty cells as null; six whole/tail/time groups per split and every per-seed native aggregate retained. No sign-based filtering.
checks.additivity: AE, SE and signed-error sums checked for disjoint pattern and pattern×magnitude partitions; no additive RMSE claim.
checks.uncertainty: Same jointly trained checkpoint branch sensitivity only. No new model success, causal isolation, independent generalization or significance claim.
checks.immutability: Exclusive output directory/files; dependency SHA recheck before and after output. Same predictive state before/after and between fresh on/off, plus unchanged Runtime, checked.

synthetic_validation.random_check_method: Deterministic seeds0..29; 3seeds×Train/Validation with shared and split-only entities, unequal entity sizes, positive/negative errors and sparse cells. Independently recomputed weighted MAE/RMSE/AE/SE/signed sums and off-on direction.

limitations: No actual native run, real input/prediction rows, checkpoint deserialization or completed-receipt integration was executed in this review.
Operational collector/worker validation is handled by separate QA; its final pinned implementation and native receipts remain prerequisites.
Three-seed summary excludes a cell if any seed lacks support, but all per-seed nulls and support counts remain preserved.
The immutable helper uses internal variable names candidate/cnn; public result nested metric roles are off/on and helper predictions are never historical CNN rows.
recommendation: Proceed to the separately reviewed operational implementation and gated native diagnostic. After native completion, run this fixed analysis once and independently verify output SHA/counts; do not interpret this synthetic PASS as diagnostic completion.
